scripts.dev: npm run build:functions && node scripts/emulators.mjs exec "npm run seed && node scripts/dev-session.mjs"
scripts.emulators: npm run build:functions && node scripts/emulators.mjs start
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w functions
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w scripts && npm run typecheck -w functions
scripts.serve: npm run build && node scripts/emulators.mjs exec --hosting "npm run seed && node scripts/wait-forever.mjs"
scripts.test: npm test -w shared && npm test -w functions
scripts.test:functions: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-ajay --only firestore,functions "node --import tsx --test functions/test/callables.test.ts"
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-ajay-rules --only firestore,storage "node --import tsx --test tests/rules/rules.test.ts"
scripts.test:feeds: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-ajay-feeds --only firestore,auth,storage,functions "node --import tsx --test functions/test/feeds.test.ts"
